svg.title: AI Grocery Assistant: your cart, read back to you. An intelligent grocery shopping companion that looks at what is in your cart and suggests what goes with it, with a plain language reason for every pick. Rules choose the products, an LLM explains and ranks them, and the app works with or without an API key. Built with Next.js and FastAPI. Animated example: a cart with Organic Whole Milk; the assistant answers with Greek Yogurt Plain, confidence 92, a protein rich breakfast pairing; Cheddar Cheese Block, confidence 85, a classic dairy combination; and Free Range Eggs, because milk and eggs are breakfast staples. Numbers: 15 products, 147 seeded reviews, 13 cart pairing rules, 3 AI Picks per cart, 52 backend tests.

div.h1: Your cart, read back to you.
div.p: A grocery companion that looks at what is already in your cart and suggests what goes with it, with a reason for every pick. Rules choose the products, an LLM ranks and explains them, and nothing breaks when the LLM is not there.
div.div: Next.js front end · FastAPI back end · OpenRouter for the language model
